item.title: Contact info for Jörg Hunziger
item.description:
Hello,

I am trying to track down any contact information for the type designer Jörg Hunziger, who worked with Adrian Frutiger in his paris studio (for some research for an exhibition). If anyone knows anything I will be more than happy.

Thank you!

item.title: Contact for Linotype/Monotype
item.description:
Hello,

Does anyone have a contact person at Linotype that I can contact for permission to alter one of their fonts in order to create a corporate typeface?

Thanks,
Kristin
